column1: # Shared storage initialization and parameterized octal/hex completion.
# Caller supplies ibytes and INITADDR storage descriptor for automatic/global/block-static arrays.
# Zero-fill first; emit at most ibytes decoded bytes and a fitting NUL; read NEXT exactly once.
# Walk decodes [ps+1,pe-1) into bv; resume at $walk_w. Octal has 1..3 digits; hex needs >=1.
# Row callers retain byte-relative ioff and provide str_base for shared address spelling.
